input.quote: Client will pay TrueLink's fees for requested Hosting Services and Support Services pursuant to the schedule of charges set forth on Exhibits "A" and "B" attached hereto, (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services).
input.rationale: Section 5(a) does impose a minimum monthly fee for Hosting and Support Services, so we are not at the preferred "usage/ordered services only" position, but the arrangement sits comfortably at the fallback. The commitment is confined to the current one-year term (Section 13, auto-renewing only absent 30 days' non-renewal notice), and Section 14 lets Client exit at will by written notice, with services and fees running only to the last day of the month following notice — an exit of roughly 30-60 days. There is no shortfall charge, take-or-pay penalty, unwind of discounts, or volume cap on Client's usage anywhere in the agreement, and no multi-year lock-in. Minor points noted but not flagged: the minimum amounts are left blank ($____), the cross-references to "Section 4" appear to be mis-numbered references to the compensation section, and Section 14's "Subject to Section 4" could be read as preserving minimums through the notice period. These are drafting clean-ups rather than material failures of the fallback.
